import pathlib,subprocess,json,time,os
root=pathlib.Path('.ai-core');v=root/'distillation-venv';py=str(v/'bin/python')
assert v.is_dir() and not v.is_symlink()
# Dependencies were downloaded in previous run; install separately from torch.
# Exact pins taken from previous pip resolution log.
deps=['filelock==4.2.4','typing_extensions==4.16.0','setuptools==78.1.0','sympy==1.14.0','networkx==3.7','jinja2==3.1.6','fsspec==2026.9.0','mpmath==1.3.0','markupsafe==3.0.3']

with (root/'distillation-setup.log').open('ab') as log:
    try: rc=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=20).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: rc=124
